background.value: Plain, light background; illumination must be uniform with no shadows on the face or behind the subject

head_height.value: Head must occupy 70–80% of the photo

expression_restriction.value: Straight-looking, centered, neutral expression; eyes must be open

glasses_policy.value: Prescription glasses permitted if clear and thin-framed, with no flash reflection obscuring vision

headwear_policy.value: Head coverings, hair, head-dress, or facial ornaments must not obscure the face

accessories.value: No other people or objects may appear in the photo; no red-eye effects allowed

expression.en: Face the camera straight on, centered in the frame, with a neutral expression; eyes must be open.
expression.ko: 카메라를 정면으로 응시하고 화면 중앙에 위치하며 무표정을 유지해야 한다. 눈은 뜬 상태여야 한다.
expression.ja: カメラに対して正面を向き、画面中央に位置し、無表情を保つこと。目は開けていなければならない。

glasses.en: Prescription glasses are permitted if clear and thin-framed, with no flash reflection obscuring vision.
glasses.ko: 얇은 무테·투명 테 안경은 허용되나, 플래시 반사로 시야가 가려지면 안 된다.
glasses.ja: 薄いフレームの透明な眼鏡は許可されるが、フラッシュの反射で視界が隠れてはならない。

headwear.en: Head coverings, hair, headdresses, or facial ornaments must not obscure the face.
headwear.ko: 머리쓰개, 머리카락, 장식물이 얼굴을 가려서는 안 된다.
headwear.ja: 帽子・ヘアスタイル・ヘッドドレスや装飾品が顔を隠してはならない。

accessories.en: No other people or objects may appear in the photo; red-eye effects are not permitted.
accessories.ko: 사진에 다른 사람이나 물체가 나오면 안 되며, 적목현상도 허용되지 않는다.
accessories.ja: 写真に他の人物や物体が写ってはならず、赤目現象も許可されない。

cross_verification.note_en: Fiji Ministry of Immigration's official 'Guidelines for Passport Photographs' page confirms size (3.5×4.5cm, matching DB exactly — no conflict) and head-height as a 70–80% ratio (≈3.15–3.6cm on a 4.5cm-tall photo, roughly consistent with DB's 3.2–3.6cm — not flagged as a conflict since the source states a ratio, not a fixed cm figure). The source's own text reads '70 to 80% of the photo or one inch height'; one inch (25.4mm) does not reconcile with 70–80% of a 45mm-tall photo (31.5–36mm, a ~6–11mm gap versus the ±1.5mm self-consistency tolerance), so the 'one inch' alternate figure was dropped and only the internally-consistent percentage figure retained. Background is stated as 'plain light background' rather than specifically 'white'; since white falls within 'light', this was not flagged as a conflict. Photo validity period, clothing rules, and ear visibility are not stated on this page.
